name: log_rotate
desc: [维护] 日志生命周期轮换(#418)：toolout>7天/扫描记录>30天移入归档，归档>30天清理；默认dry-run，apply=1实际执行
params: apply:string:1=实际执行,默认dry-run|toolout_days:string:toolout保留天数,默认7|scan_days:string:扫描记录保留天数,默认30
cmd: a=; [ x$apply = x1 ] && a=--apply; td=7; [ x$toolout_days != x ] && td=$toolout_days; sd=30; [ x$scan_days != x ] && sd=$scan_days; /system/bin/timeout 45 /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/python3 /data/lemonbrain/maintenance/log_rotate.py $a --toolout-days $td --scan-days $sd
